import os, docx, json
p = "_conversations/20261031-091758_f9be"
files = os.listdir(p)
main = [f for f in files if f.endswith('.docx') and '纯答案' not in f][0]
ans = [f for f in files if '纯答案' in f][0]

out = []
for label, fn in [("MAIN", main), ("ANS", ans)]:
    path = os.path.join(p, fn)
    d = docx.Document(path)
    out.append(f"===== {label}: {fn} =====")
    out.append(f"段落数={len(d.paragraphs)} 表格数={len(d.tables)}")
    # body children order
    from docx.oxml.ns import qn
    body = d.element.body
    idx_p = 0; idx_t = 0
    for child in body.iterchildren():
        if child.tag == qn('w:p'):
            par = docx.text.paragraph.Paragraph(child, d)
            imgs = child.findall('.//'+qn('a:blip'))
            has_img = len(imgs) > 0
            out.append(f"[P{idx_p}] img={has_img} :: {par.text}")
            idx_p += 1
        elif child.tag == qn('w:tbl'):
            tbl = docx.table.Table(child, d)
            out.append(f"[TABLE{idx_t}] rows={len(tbl.rows)}")
            for r in tbl.rows:
                out.append("   | " + " || ".join(c.text.replace("\n"," / ") for c in r.cells))
            idx_t += 1
open("_dump.txt","w",encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(out))
print("OK", len(out))
